_comment: RUN QUEUE P1 (docs/RUNQUEUE_pdfix_reask.md) - D5 policy matrix on the WORKING fold.
Control is runs/pdfix_on (D5 v2 as-is): 18559 flags, 23675 births, 20330 refloats,
sigma0-hat 4.05, mature steps 1.015/0.883/0.509 cyc/ep, SF k=1 0.83 cyc,
ONE variable vs that control; everything else is _ft63_pdfix_on.json verbatim.
ARM v3 - corroboration gate: a flagged chord is re-tapped ONLY unless the raw MW/GF
observables positively measured its arc CONTINUOUS.  THE HIGH-STAKES ARM of P1.
It suppresses the measured-and-flat population - on the corrupt substrate 96.5% of flags -
so chords are allowed to MATURE THROUGH iono tension instead of being reset by it.  That
is the point AND the risk: standing invariant #1 says a stiff time-linked quantity
carrying a stale value past a real event warps the whole solution.  The tension does not
vanish; it has to land somewhere.
GRADE WHERE IT LANDS, not whether flags fell: total_IF hr2 (does the undischarged
tension reach the products?), the SH a00 band, post-fit sigma0_phase, clock QC, and the
arc-refloat / IF-TD coarse layer (which is UNTOUCHED and must still catch real slips).
A total_IF or clock-QC degradation here is a STOP, not a trade.
